label_scope: SOC_proxy only; not independent true SOC
prediction_commit: score each mission before any current-cycle reference is released
request_reference_apply: request after a mission; use the next selected completed candidate RPT; apply head from first later mission index
reference_data: three low-rate discharge phase endpoints Ns 3/5/7 with capacity measured by that completed RPT
update: bounded affine correction y=a*p+b, prior (a,b)=(1,0), prior strength 3; latest RPT replaces prior head

indicators.model_disagreement: absolute difference between N20 phase Ridge prediction and 3 Ah coulomb-counter estimate
indicators.voltage_residual: absolute residual of N20-trained phase minimum-voltage Ridge using phase, duration, current, Vmax and temperature; Vmin target is excluded from inputs; not an ECM time-series residual
indicators.page_hinkley: Page-Hinkley-style cumulative standardized residual with running minimum; delta=0.5, threshold=5; fixed training center
indicators.cusum: one-sided cumulative standardized residual; kappa=0.25, threshold=5
indicators.adwin_like: fixed 20-vs-20 mean-shift check; not a full adaptive ADWIN implementation
indicators.threshold: N20 median + 3 robust standard deviations; no test-time threshold search

budget: B is a maximum number of completed RPT references; actual count is reported; periodic/random/hybrid use evenly spaced or sampled observed opportunities

configuration.label_scope: SOC_proxy only; not independent true SOC
configuration.model_disagreement: absolute N20 phase Ridge prediction minus nominal-3-Ah coulomb-counter estimate

head_update.form: bounded affine calibration y = a*p + b

excluded: FBG-based SRA from FiberResearch; eVTOL data contain no FBG signal
